MAPS

CONTROLS

Touch

Left stick to move. Drag anywhere on the right half to look around.

JUMP and CROUCH sit above the right thumb.

Fists equipped → PUNCH button (alternates left / right jab).

RCV2 equipped → SHOOT (grab), + (spawn), and DELETE buttons.

The three lines in the top left open the spawn menu.

USE picks up a weapon, and wears the Light Vest. Press it again to put it down.

The button beside PAUSE fills the screen, and fills it back.

Fire Fist (once you have earned it) → PUNCH sets people alight, FIREBALL throws fire.

Keyboard & mouse

WASD move · Mouse look (click to lock) · Space jump · C or Ctrl crouch

1 fists · 2 RCV2 · 3-8 whatever you are carrying · 9 Fire Fist · R reload

Q or right click throws a fireball with the Fire Fist · Space skips a cutscene

Left click punch / grab · E use · G spawn · X delete · Tab spawn menu
